plan.title: Closed RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Configure post-expiry surrogate bidding as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Restrict evaluation reopening as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Edit Evaluation Time without confirming any change.
Verify that the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Verify the duration-editing option is present.
Verify the ending-time editing option is present.
